notes.title: Small dialogue fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue that could get people stuck in a specific dialogue

notes.title: More bugfixes!
notes.content:
Fighters!

As promised, today comes a new update!
So this is mostly a bugfix, I just added one new feature. 
If you happen to find any issue, as usual, just let me know and I will fix it as soon as I can!

As an apology for the issues, I added a small cheat that you can use one time to get 25000 credits!
Go to the cheats area an put the code “55671”
Once again, sorry for the inconveniences, and I hope you enjoy the game!

Have a great weekend!

Changelog 1.0.3
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with some achievements becoming unlocked when they shouldn’t
[*] Moved the buy button on the shop, and made it auto-select when clicking on clothing, to make it more convenient when buying stuff in bulk
[*] Fixed a bunch of other issues related to achievements
[*] Fixed an issue with some endgame characters having the wrong gender in dialogues
[*] Rebalanced player and enemy progression on story mode to make enemies in chapter 2 less deadly
[*] Fixed some typos in the introductory dialogues
[*] Fixed an issue with the toggle for realtime mode on the campaign
[*] Fixed an issue in customization where headgears lose their shininess value
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed players to use threesomes in story mode before intended
[*] Added a new cheat code for free coins.
[*] Added a new feature: Sweatiness mode! (When enabled characters become more sweaty as the match goes on, this is just visual and has no gameplay impact)
[/list]

notes.title: Another small fix!

Changelog - 1.0.2
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with some stats not being reset properly on next campaign character start
[*] Fixed an issue with Chaos mode getting stuck sometimes
[*] Added a dark background behind the Pleasure bars for better visibility
[*] Added a failsafe to add basic clothing unlocks in case you didn’t get it because you had a very old version save
[*] Fixed an issue with undressing and dick activation
[*] Backbreaker titsuck now properly works for F/F situations
[*] Added missing testers to the credits!
[*] Fixed spellcheck bad replacement of words in the tutorial 
[/list]

notes.title: Quickfix!
notes.content:
Fighters!

I come with a small update to fix some issues!

1.0.1 - 
Fixed an issue with story progress on late game events
Fixed an issue with Valerie/Giovanni romance path
Fixed an issue with Lenna having the wrong pose and expression in the main menu
Fixed an issue with dialogue system showing invalid entries
Fixed an issue with dialogue system getting stuck if you pressed Escape key
Added a text file to indicate how to share characters and outfits


If have a minute please review the game, it really helps us!

If you happen to find any bug or issue let me know so I can fix it!
Have a great weekend!
